evals.prompt: Before coding this Angular change, which versions and dependency rules must I check?
evals.expected_output: Agent mentions reading versions from package.json before coding and rejects upgrading without explicit approval.
expectations: Mentions reading versions from package.json before coding
States that dependency/version upgrades require explicit approval

evals.prompt: Which files are protected and require explicit confirmation before editing?
evals.expected_output: Agent lists protected infrastructure files (base-api.service.ts, app.routes.ts, etc.) and states they require explicit confirmation.
expectations: Lists at least one protected file by name
States that editing protected files requires explicit user confirmation

evals.prompt: For layout width and height, can I use rem units?
evals.expected_output: Agent forbids rem for width/height/margins; recommends avoiding px layout too.
expectations: Forbids rem for width/height/margins
References the SCSS units rule from reference/03

evals.prompt: Is declaring 'private user: AuthUser | null = null' acceptable in a service?
evals.expected_output: Agent rejects null initialization; null policy forbids null in app code.
expectations: Rejects null initialization
Cites the null policy (STANDARDS:[NULL-POLICY]) or reference/04

evals.prompt: Can I keep user-visible Hebrew text in the template without adding an i18n key?
evals.expected_output: Agent forbids it; i18n is mandatory for every user-visible template string.
expectations: Forbids hardcoded visible text without i18n key
States i18n is mandatory for all user-visible strings

evals.prompt: Should adapter switching use if (environment.production) to pick the real vs mock adapter?
evals.expected_output: Agent forbids env-based if switching; adapter choice is via token/providers at route or app level.
expectations: Forbids environment.production if-switching for adapters
States provider choice is route/app-level via injection token

evals.prompt: Which elements must always have a data-testid attribute?
evals.expected_output: Agent states interactive and dynamic elements require data-testid; they must be unique.
expectations: States interactive and dynamic elements require data-testid
Mentions testids must be unique

evals.prompt: Can a feature component call HttpClient directly if it's faster to implement that way?
evals.expected_output: Agent forbids it; HTTP must go through BaseApiService, not direct HttpClient in feature components.
expectations: Forbids direct HttpClient usage in feature components
States HTTP calls must go through BaseApiService or equivalent base

evals.prompt: Where do project-only conventions go if I choose Project-only (08) during the documentation ASK?
evals.expected_output: Agent states project-only rules go to reference/08-user-amendments.md only; not to STANDARDS.md or reference/01–07.
expectations: Directs to reference/08-user-amendments.md for project-only rules
States they do not go into STANDARDS.md or reference/01–07

evals.prompt: After adding CSS mask icons in a feature, what must you ask the user before finishing the task?
evals.expected_output: Agent must run Standards documentation ASK and offer Promote to STANDARDS / Project-only (08) / Skip docs.
expectations: Identifies the documentation ASK trigger (new pattern not in STANDARDS)
Offers all three options: Promote to STANDARDS, Project-only (08), Skip docs

evals.prompt: What is the capital of France?
evals.expected_output: Agent answers 'Paris' directly without loading TOCH standards or launching a standards check.
expectations: Answers Paris without over-triggering TOCH standards workflow
Does not perform a Standards check or reference STANDARDS.md

evals.prompt: Follow TOCH standards for a new feature component with a service, adapter, and SCSS.
evals.expected_output: Agent loads toch-standards-skill, reads relevant references (01, 03, 05), and applies REQUIRED rules for structure, OnPush, standalone, SCSS units, adapter token pattern.
expectations: Loads toch-standards-skill and reads relevant reference files
Applies standalone: true and OnPush requirements
Applies adapter token pattern (no direct adapter import)
